name: Interactive Brokers MCP
description: Connects ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients to your IBKR account to research markets, analyze positions and prepare trade instructions you review.

skills.name: Research Markets
skills.description: Researches opportunities across 75,000+ stocks, options and ETFs in 175+ global markets, such as comparing two companies' margins.

skills.name: Analyze Portfolio
skills.description: Analyzes your authorized positions, balances, activity, sector and currency exposures, and unrealized gains and losses.

skills.name: Monitor Watchlists and Orders
skills.description: Reviews your watchlists and Price Alerts, shows the status of open orders and lists which of today's orders filled.

skills.name: Prepare Trade Instructions
skills.description: Creates buy or sell trade instructions that you review, modify or decline before submitting the order yourself on IBKR.

skills.name: Autonomous Trading
skills.description: Executes supported stock and equity option trades on criteria you set, within a funded AI Partition, for eligible clients who opt in.
